purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard medical receipt (claim) software. It aggregates and edits point-score data broken down by diagnosis/treatment category for insurance claim receipts (レセプト). It handles complex Japanese medical insurance billing rules including co-payment amounts, special items, and various insurance combinations.

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the comments contain Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP (or Shift-JIS), which appears garbled under latin-1 decoding. This is cosmetic only and does not affect the COBOL classification. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system, confirming its production nature. The large size (359 KB, 7380 lines) and extensive change log are consistent with a long-lived production component.
